responsibility: Defines the main MIR codegen orchestration state for rustc_codegen_ssa, including FunctionCx, local representations, cached backend blocks, unwind and funclet state, debug state, argument setup, monomorphization helpers, and cold-block discovery used across MIR lowering.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other same-basename files, this `mod.rs` is the implementation-heavy MIR lowering root: it defines `FunctionCx`, local/block bookkeeping, and codegen entry logic, then wires in MIR submodules beneath it. It is not merely a module aggregator like `back` or `coverageinfo`, nor an interface surface like `traits`.
